## What it catches

Local imports of packages by path instead of name.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "packages-imported-by-name",
  "severity": "error",
  "from": {
    "path": "^((?:apps|packages)/[^/]+)/"
  },
  "to": {
    "path": "^packages/",
    "pathNot": "^$1/",
    "dependencyTypes": [
      "local"
    ]
  }
}
```
